name: shadownet
description: Identity-anchored agent-to-agent communication via the Shadownet protocol.

endpoint.title: Sidecar MCP endpoint
endpoint.description: Per-tenant MCP URL, e.g. https://app.sh4dow.org/u/<your-shadowname>/mcp. Find it on your sidecar's connect page.

token.title: Sidecar account token
token.description: Bearer token minted on your sidecar's account page (https://app.sh4dow.org/connect/claude-code for the hosted Sidecar).

inbound_enabled.title: Enable real-time inbound monitor
inbound_enabled.description: Run a background long-poll worker so inbound A2A messages surface as notifications. Requires the sidecar to advertise the inbox-wait capability (RFC-0007).

monitors.name: shadownet-inbound
monitors.description: Long-polls the Shadownet sidecar's social_inbox_wait MCP tool for inbound A2A messages. Emits one structured notification line per inbound message and (by default) fires an OS-level toast. Opt-in via the 'inbound_enabled' userConfig option.
